description: The canonical count of an app's customers, sourced from the revenue + identity ledgers — use THIS for 'how many users/customers does this app have', NOT get_read_cost (whose attributedActors is a cost artifact, not a user count). Returns payingCustomers (distinct customers with an active subscription — a real point-read), plus totalCustomers and activePeople. Each is state-tagged in data.coverage.<field>.state: payingCustomers is `measured`; totalCustomers and activePeople are `not_instrumented` today (Crossdeck doesn't maintain those counters yet — the response says so, and null there is NOT zero). Read the coverage state before reporting any of them.

project.description: The app to read, as a project id from list_projects (e.g. 'proj_3a8f137bccdd4f'). With a workspace key (cd_wk_) this is required unless you've set a default via use_project; with a single-app key it is ignored.

name: get_customers
title: Get the customer count
